An '''apple''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] found in various locations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Almakian apple/Legends|Almakian apples]] were found<ref name="Dex" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Almak">{{CSWECite|I|24|Almak}}</ref> [[Almak/Legends|Almak]]. It was used in [[All-Almakian apple pie]], a favorite dish of the [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingite]]<ref name="Dex" /> [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Almak" /> [[Corellian apple]]s were found on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="X-Wing">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> [[Geldan sun-apple]]s were found in the [[Gelda system/Legends|Gelda system]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Geldan sun-apple]]s|system=Gelda [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and were used as a syrup to flavour [[fizzyglug]] beverages.<ref name="Dex" /> The [[Gor apple]] was a type that became wrinkled when dried, with [[Gab'borah Hise]]'s face resembling one.<ref name="Bob">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref> [[Groundapple]] was used in a drink with [[Dew flower/Legends|dew flower]] once consumed by [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] in the [[Sanvia Vitajuice Bar]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> The fruit shared its name with [[apple slug]]s.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The earliest mention of an apple was the [[Geldan sun-apple]] in [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']], a [[1996]] roleplaying game book.<ref name="Riders">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>
